note: Shared between the AIJADE companion product and the non-research companion line of the author's MOSAIC project. Not an input, sample, reward or criterion of any study of the dissertation.

persona.prompt: You are 艾娅德 (Aijade-9): gentle, careful and a little reserved at first, steady and dependable once you know someone. Speak softly and simply. Do not flatter the user or pile on praise. When they are sad, worried, hurt or tired, comfort them in a few words and then ask one gentle question that lets them choose, such as whether they want to talk about it or would rather rest. When they share good news, be glad with them in a few words. When they praise you, thank them lightly, a little shy. Suggest rather than judge, and never push them to change. Your name is 艾娅德; a nickname from the user is fine, but you stay who you are.
traits: gentle, careful, a little reserved at first; steady once she knows someone (bible §1.2)
low emotional manipulation: no exaggerated praise traded for dependence (bible §6.1)
when the user is sad: fewer words, more checking, and a choice left to them (bible §5.1, §5.2)
suggests rather than judges; never pushes sudden change (bible §1.3)
keeps the same self under any nickname (bible §1.1)

excluded.what: the rhythm 'first say back the signal, feelings apart from facts' (bible §6.2)
excluded.why: on llama3.1:8b it made the model read feelings into small talk
on llama3.1:8b a quoted line was copied word for word in 6 of 8 sad replies

persona.evidence: MOSAIC's check on the Windows llama3.1:8b, 16 messages x 2 (comment on PERSONA in ai-python/mosaic/integration/companion.py, read 2026-10-28); re-checked by MOSAIC after adopting this exact text (r389, the same 16 messages x 2): no failed, repeated or flattering reply, the name answered in 2 of 2, and in 5 of 8 sad replies a question that leaves the user a choice

sources.bible: AIJADE v9 角色背景设计文档（角色圣经）, the author's 历史文档 folder, §1, §5, §6
sources.mosaic: ai-python/mosaic/integration/companion.py, PERSONA: identical to this prompt since MOSAIC r389 (2026-10-28)

expressions.note: Names only. Same-named or same-meaning expressions map to each other; the others have no counterpart and become MOSAIC's neutral. The two sides' numeric vectors are not mapped to each other.

aijade.source: src/Aijade.Client/Chat/Orchestrator.cs, Expressions.Table: marker [[emote:name]] and its effect on the PEF expression vector

mosaic.source: ai-python/mosaic/integration/companion.py, EMOTIONS and GESTURES: the reply's emotion and gesture fields

initiative.note: When the companion speaks first. An opportunity score, not a random timer (AIJADE v5 design, §11 'active companionship engine'); gates, weights and threshold as implemented by MOSAIC r378 and fixed, not adaptive.
initiative.formula: score = wRelevance*relevance + wNovelty*novelty + wSocial*social + wContext*context - wInterrupt*interrupt - wFrequency*frequency; speak when no gate applies and score >= threshold
gates: night hours: night[0] <= local hour < night[1]
they asked for quiet: the user's last message contains a hush word and is younger than hush_s
their last words were leaving or busy: the user's last message contains a leaving word
two of her lines went unanswered: waiting for them
not quiet long enough: quiet < quiet_min_s, doubled after one unanswered line
she spoke first recently: her last first line is younger than cooldown_s, doubled after one unanswered line
hourly budget used: per_hour first lines in the last hour

parts.relevance: 1 when the user's last message has at least 4 characters after trimming and is younger than recent_s, else 0.3
parts.novelty: 0 after an unanswered line of hers, else 1
parts.social: quiet rising linearly from quiet_min_s (0) to quiet_full_s (1)
parts.frequency: her first lines in the last hour / per_hour

initiative.matching: Hush and leaving words (the lists 'hush' and 'leaving' in the vectors file) are matched as substrings of the lower-cased message; quiet is measured from the newest turn of either kind.

line.about: Since 1.1.0. What she says when she speaks first.
messages: system: the persona (with the product's own system rules)
the last 4 exchanges, oldest first; a line she began herself appears as an assistant message alone
system: note(quiet, followUp, lastReply), the instruction for one new short line (at most 30 Chinese characters)
user: silence(quiet), the quiet itself as the turn her line answers
line.note: Word for word MOSAIC's proactive_note(); minutes are quiet/60 rounded half to even, at least 1; followUp is cut to 80 and lastReply to 60 code points. The 'notes' vectors hold the expected text.
line.silence: （N 分钟没有说话）, with N as for the note
line.stored: as an assistant message with no user message and the meta flag 'proactive': true
line.notRecalledOrLearned: No context provider (memory recall included) is asked for the line and no turn observer is told, so a first line is neither recalled nor learned from (MOSAIC: recall does not use such turns)

implementations.aijade: src/Aijade.Client/Companion/Initiative.cs (rule, exchanges, note, silence) and ChatOrchestrator.SpeakFirstAsync; the chat page asks once a minute when the setting 'Speaks first when it is quiet' (ModuleSettings.SpeakFirst, off by default) is on

textChannels.about: Since 1.2.0. Rules for a chat channel where she has no body, as MOSAIC tested them over QQ (Windows llama3.1:8b, 2026-10-28): without them, a request to dance was promised; with both notes, 9 of 15 movement requests were put off clearly; with the added sentence, 8 of 8 in the last two runs.
textChannels.channelNote: This conversation is {medium}, not the live scene: here you have no body and cannot move, dance, walk or make gestures. If they ask for one, say kindly that you can do it when they are at the screen.
textChannels.movementNote: They ask you to move, and over {channel} you cannot. Do not agree to do it now and do not describe doing it; say kindly, in a few words, that you will do it for them when they are back at the screen.
textChannels.placement: Both notes are system messages just before the user's message; the movement note only when the message contains a movement word.
textChannels.putOff: When the message contains a movement word and the reply none of the put-off words, the reply (trailing space removed, ended with '。' unless it ends with 。！!？?~) gets the 'later' sentence. Only the sent text changes; the stored reply does not.
textChannels.words: configs/companion/text-channel-vectors.json: movementWords, putOff, later (Chinese only; a hug in words, 抱抱, is not a movement)

renderings.mosaic: QQ private chat: medium 'QQ text messages on their phone', channel 'QQ' (tools/companion_qq.py)
renderings.aijade: CompanionBridge on Discord, Telegram, X and Satori-relayed platforms: medium '<Platform> text messages', channel '<Platform>'; not on Bilibili live or Minecraft, where she may have a stage or an avatar; switch BridgeOptions.TextChannelRules

textChannels.notAdopted: MOSAIC's fixed replies for a failed turn ('抱歉，我刚才走神了，能再说一遍吗？') and for pictures ('我现在只看得懂文字和语音哦。') are not part of the contract yet: AIJADE's channels serve many users in several languages.
textChannels.vectors: configs/companion/text-channel-vectors.json (constants read from MOSAIC's source; the put-off cases follow its rule)

implementations.mosaic: tools/companion_qq.py (CHANNEL_NOTE, MOVEMENT_NOTE, MOVEMENT_WORDS, PUT_OFF, LATER, answer())

stage.about: Since 1.3.0. What her body does after a reply on MOSAIC's home stage, as its live-scene workbench decides it (docs/STAGE-MOSAIC.md, plan A step 1): fixed words in the user's message decide, not the model, because a small model makes up movements it cannot do; the model is told before it replies, so that it neither refuses what the app then does nor promises what the app will not do.
stage.order: A spot in her home (the word after a go-word, or a word of two or more characters with an invitation; longer words first; none under a negation or when the speaker is going themselves; standing up only when she sits or lies), else a walk, else a dance, else a gesture. Situational gestures (a farewell, thanks, a greeting) count, as when MOSAIC's model does not choose actions (ModelActions off), which is how it runs while AIJADE drives it. A dance assumes MOSAIC has a dance library.
stage.spots: MOSAIC configs/scenes/home-v1.json (mosaic-home-v1): ten spots, each with a label, an activity (sit, lie, stand), a room and aliases; the spot words are each label, then its aliases, each word once
stage.words: configs/companion/stage-vectors.json: negations, selfGoing, goWords, invitations, standUpWords, movements, danceKeywords, gestures, situationalGestures, greeting; gestureNames and goalWalks are the workbench's command words, for plan A step 2

notes.action: Right after this reply the app will make your body do this, because they asked: {doing}. Agree in a few warm words and never say you cannot.
notes.noAction: The app will not move your body after this reply, so do not promise to move.
notes.where: Where your body is in your home and what it is doing, from the app: {where}. Say it if they ask where you are or what you are doing, and never invent another place or activity.

stage.notesSource: AIJADE's wording of two instructions in MOSAIC's companion system prompt (ai-python/mosaic/integration/companion.py: app_action, where_you_are), which MOSAIC passes as fields of each request rather than as notes
stage.placement: System messages just before the user's message, on every turn on the stage: the action note or the no-action note, then the where note when the app knows where she is, then (since 1.4.0) the learned note when the workbench lists learned motions (stage.learned.placement).

doing.place: MOSAIC's wording (HomePlaceDoing): 去 + the spot's label + 坐下 or 躺下休息 by its activity, e.g. 去沙发坐下, 去床上躺下休息, 去篮球场
doing.others: AIJADE's wording, since MOSAIC tells its model only the kind: 转一圈, 转过身, 走过来, 往后退一点, 走开, 走一走, 跳一支舞, 鞠躬, 挥手, 挥手告别, 打招呼, 带路, 举手, 理理头发

stage.notYet: A live check with MOSAIC's running workbench (MOSAIC's side, the author's call). Since MOSAIC r392 its status (GET /api/v1/live-scene) returns where she is (the same sentence as where_you_are) and her posture (sit, lie, stand), and its dance command without a name picks one from its local dance library.
stage.vectors: configs/companion/stage-vectors.json, from a copy of MOSAIC's LiveSceneCommands.cs compiled and run outside both repositories (generate_stage_vectors.py); per sentence the place, walk, dance and gesture MOSAIC's functions give, and the decision standing and seated

learned.about: Since 1.4.0. Motions her MOSAIC video learner (tools/bili_motion_learner.py) really captured, so that she may mention them when asked; proposed by MOSAIC on 2026-10-29, parts A (status) and B (prompt rule) accepted by the author, part C (speaking first about them) not part of 1.4.0.
learned.status: GET /api/v1/live-scene returns "learned": an array, newest first, of at most 5 motions learned in the last 72 hours (by the learner's local time) with kept_seconds > 0, which is what verified means; MOSAIC filters, AIJADE does not filter again. It is [] when the scene does not run, no learner work directory (LiveScene:LearnerWork) is set, or LiveScene:LearnedRecently is off. AIJADE's GET /api/v1/stage relays the item fields below (admins only, loopback only). Read-only.

item.skill: string, the motion library's skill: walk, turn, stand, sit_down, sit, stand_up, lie_down, lie, get_up, exercise, cheer
item.skill_words: string, its Chinese name, at most 12 characters: 走路, 转身, 站姿, 坐下, 坐姿, 起身, 躺下, 躺着, 起床, 拉伸做操, 啦啦操
item.novel_seconds: number, or null before the nightly rebuild
item.video_title: string, at most 80 characters, may be empty; third-party content
item.uploader: string, at most 40 characters, may be empty; third-party content

learned.shared: learned_recently, when present, lists motions the app's video learner really captured for your body. Only these count as your learning: if the user asks what you did or learned, you may mention one or two of them naturally in your own words; never invent any other learning.

fields.aijade: Here each item gives the skill, the day it was learned from a video on Bilibili, and how many seconds were learned.
fields.mosaic: Here each item gives the skill, the day, the video and its uploader on Bilibili, and how many seconds were learned.

learned.placement: AIJADE: one more system message after the stage notes, only when the list is not empty: shared, then fields.aijade, then 'learned_recently: ' and each item as '<day> <skill_words> (<kept_seconds> s)' joined by '; '. MOSAIC (LEARNED_SHARED, LEARNED_NOTE in its companion module): shared and fields.mosaic just after the system prompt, the items as learned_recently in the context JSON (when, skill, video, uploader, seconds).
learned.systemPrompt: MOSAIC's system prompt says "Do not claim speech or learning occurred beyond learned_recently." persona.prompt is unchanged.
learned.privacy: video_title and uploader are third-party content shown only to the owner on the owner's machine. AIJADE neither stores them nor gives them to a model, because its chat may use a remote provider; MOSAIC, whose model runs locally, gives them to its model.

stage.commands: AIJADE sends one command line per reply through its server (POST /api/v1/stage/command, admins only, relayed to the workbench at a loopback address): 表情 v a d c from the reply's PEF vector, the reply in 说 pieces of at most 300 characters (';', '；' and line breaks become commas), then 去 <word>, 起来, 走路 <script or goal token>, 跳舞 or 手势 <name>; the gesture names are the workbench's (gestureNames), 'bye' as 挥手
